Apply exactly section B of that record, the six answered technical questions, and nothing from section C (unanswered: leave those questions open exactly as they are). If no existing event kind can carry it without a contract change, do not invent one silently: write the smallest proposal as a new contract or engine plan task and say so in your summary, or, if even that needs a decision the documents do not contain, report the exact question.
